subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Which durable subagent completion delivery policy should own this umbrella before accepting retry-only or auto-restart fixes?
rationale: The bug is real, but the fix changes cross-channel completion durability, requester wake semantics, task-ledger state, and duplicate-prevention behavior, which automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
options.body: Build the completion outbox/spool and delivery state model as the canonical fix, then treat retry-only PRs as partial mitigations.

options.title: Land a narrow mitigation first
options.body: Require #90561 or a successor to resolve conflicts, prove live behavior, and explicitly document which durable-delivery gaps remain open.

options.title: Split the umbrella
options.body: Move ownership to narrower canonical issues for durable spool, sessions_yield wake, active-run consumption, and transcript/channel ledger behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
recommendation.body: Build the completion outbox/spool and delivery state model as the canonical fix, then treat retry-only PRs as partial mitigations.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest recent history across subagent registry and announce-delivery refactors, making him the best available owner for the architecture choice.
